'''Passive Operations''' was an office within the [[Operations (Alliance Intelligence)/Legends|Operations]] department of [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]]. Despite its name, Passive Operations was anything but. The office was staffed by former [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]], elite [[Special forces/Legends|special forces]], and the best [[operative]]s culled from [[Systems Operations]] and [[Coordinate]]. Passive Operations operatives were deployed when combat with the enemy was likely and expected. Mission parameters included liberating captured [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] assets, assaults against heavily-defended installations, and the rare occasion when a straight [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] was authorized. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Passive Operations made several attempts on the life of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].<ref name="RASB" />

Passive Operations operatives commonly authored the [[SecuriDex]]s issued by [[Analysis (Alliance Intelligence)|Analysis]] that detailed potential threats to the Alliance.<ref name="AIR">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref>
